card.name: Words leading up to descendant or ancestry
card.fires_on: Linking or modifying words just before an expected word like descendant, descended or ancestry, in text about family lines, lineage and heritage.

modes.label: Group origins
modes.description: Words before a claim that a people descend from a famous ancestor.
modes.example: Some believe that the Falasha Jews of Ethiopia are<< direct>> descendants from Solomon’s time.

modes.label: Evolutionary ancestry
modes.description: Words in biology text about common ancestors and relatedness.
modes.example: All life on<< Earth>> shares a common ancestor.
